_comment: Wants (scripts/wants.gd, data/wants.json): the moment a person's want comes due, in its port. priority: it comes up as soon as you're in that port with them aboard (want_here), and again after the cooldown if you put it off.

want_debt.title: The moneylender's men
want_debt.text: Two large men and a clerk with a ledger are waiting on the quay at {port}. They want {who}, who owes 300 gold with interest, and they've waited long enough.

choices.result: The clerk strikes a line through the ledger. {who} shakes your hand and doesn't let go for a long moment.

choices.text: Tell them to come back when you've the money
choices.result: They go, for now. {who} watches them all the way up the street.
They back away from your boarding party. The debt is still owed, but the lender knows what it'll cost to collect.
choices.fail_result: It comes to cudgels on the quay, and {who} takes the worst of it.

choices.result: They take {who} away in irons. Your crew watch in silence, and every one of them is thinking: me next?

want_family.title: A family in {port}
want_family.text: {who} is at your elbow before the anchor is down. Their family lives here: up the hill, past the church. Years since they've seen them. Could they have a few days ashore?

choices.text: Take three days: the whole ship can wait
choices.result: {who} comes back with a basket of bread, a child's drawing of the ship, and a look you haven't seen on them before.

choices.text: Let them go home for good
choices.result: {who} stands on the quay with the family round them and waves until you're past the fort. The crew talk about it for days.

want_home.title: Home
want_home.text: {who} is standing at the rail, looking at {port} as if they'd forgotten it was real. They were born here. They'd like an afternoon ashore, to walk the streets they ran in as a child.

choices.text: Go with them, and stand them a drink
choices.result: They show you the house they were born in, the church where they were christened, and the tavern where they first got drunk. All three are smaller than they remembered.
An hour isn't much. They come back quieter than they went.

want_vow.title: A vow to keep
want_vow.text: {who} vowed a silver chalice to the church here if they lived through the last storm. They lived. They can't pay for it themselves, and a broken vow sits heavy.

choices.result: The priest holds the chalice up to the light. {who} kneels, and so, to your surprise, do half your crew.
It's a fine piece. {who} carries it up the hill in both hands.
{who} crosses themselves and says nothing. The superstitious among the crew don't like it.
